notes: must_not_fire CSC-VTY-0004: its catalogue title is 'A vty line has `exec-timeout 0 0` or a timeout above 10 minutes'. The assumed `vty 5 15` sub-range (line vty 0-4 is hardened; 5-15 is never configured) is evaluated against data/defaults.json's own `line.exec-timeout` default, which is `10 0` -- exactly 10 minutes, neither `0 0` nor above the 10-minute ceiling -- so the rule correctly does not fire on the assumed range. The `CSC-VTY-0001` evidence_hint (`line vty 5 15`) is absent on purpose: a failing *assumed* sub-range is an absence finding (`evidence.anchor == "absent"`, `evidence.text == ""`, confirmed against the real engine) -- there is no line to quote, by design, so no substring hint can ever match here. max_critical is 1 (the real count, CSC-VTY-0001) and max_high is 18 (the real count, 13, plus a small headroom), matching the finalized ruleset.
